Messages.Author: Chris Shorb & Tammy Martin
Messages.Body:
LSJ and All -

This question has been tearing up our play-group. If my
minion is equipped with 2 ghoul retainers and one .44
magnum, then it is said that the following happens:

My minion strike hands, GR1 does 2R with the .44 magnum.
GR2 does 2R with the .44 magnum. For a total of 5 points of
damage coming at the opposing minion.

If the above is correct, then is it true that if the same
minion is instead equipped with a grenade, then my minion
runs to long, then GR1 does 3R, and GR2 does 3R. Is this
correct? To make it a little more gross, if my minion is
equipped with 8 ghoul retainers and one grenade, then can he
do 24 points of undodgeable damage as well as whatever other
damage he may be doing? Counter-intuitive, but not adeptly
explained by the rules (the only "out" I could think of was
that indeed each GR could use the equipment, but the first
use of it burns it - but this is only tenuously upheld by
card text).

We spend about 30 minutes each night arguing this point, and
it never gets resolved.

Thanks,

Chris
(who still does not find time to read this newsgroup
regularly...)

--
Chris, Tammy and Alex
ino...@ix.netcom.com

Messages.Body:
ino...@ix.netcom.com wrote:
> LSJ and All -
>
> This question has been tearing up our play-group. If my
> minion is equipped with 2 ghoul retainers and one .44
> magnum, then it is said that the following happens:
>
> My minion strike hands, GR1 does 2R with the .44 magnum.
> GR2 does 2R with the .44 magnum. For a total of 5 points of
> damage coming at the opposing minion.

This is correct, since the rules and card text do not prohibit
this usage. [TOM 24-SEP-1995]. Curiously, the posts from MAR-1995
to DEC-1995 no longer appear on DejaNews for some reason, so
I've included the post from Tom below:

-----
From: aa...@cats.ucsc.edu (Thomas R Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad
Subject: Re: Tom: Multiple Card play Questions
Date: 24 Sep 1995 01:21:20 GMT
Message-ID: <442bqg$b...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

L. Scott Johnson <sjoh...@math.scarolina.edu> wrote:
>>>Ghoul Retainer (and both use the same weapon)
>>As written, this works, though I'm pretty sure the intention is that a given
>>weapon only be used by one minion/ally/retainer each round (see also the
>>rules on stealing equipment).
>Well, as with the intention on not playing more than one Mulitple Strike
>cards....

The latter is a case of not wishing to override what is in the rulebook.
If the rulebook had been silent on the issue, we would have ruled as
intended. In the case of two Ghouls using the same weapon, the rulebook
is silent on whether you can or can't do it, so by default you can.
I'm not sure that it's worth adding a rule.
-----

> If the above is correct, then is it true that if the same
> minion is instead equipped with a grenade, then my minion
> runs to long, then GR1 does 3R, and GR2 does 3R. Is this
> correct? To make it a little more gross, if my minion is

Yes, since the grenade is not burned until after "use", and the
uses you describe are all simultaneous.

> equipped with 8 ghoul retainers and one grenade, then can he
> do 24 points of undodgeable damage as well as whatever other
> damage he may be doing? Counter-intuitive, but not adeptly

Yes. Of course, the 8 Ghouls cost him 16 pool and 8 actions.

> explained by the rules (the only "out" I could think of was
> that indeed each GR could use the equipment, but the first
> use of it burns it - but this is only tenuously upheld by
> card text).

It isn't burned until after the use, and the 8 uses are
simultaneous.

Note that card text *does* prevent more than one ghoul from
using a sawed-off shotgun, however, since it can only be
used once.

Messages.Author: Petri Wessman
Messages.Body:
On the subject of Ghoul Retainers: say a vampire has a GR and a .44
Magnum. If the maneuver from the .44 is used to go to long range, must
the vampire strike with the gun (or is it enough for the GR to use the
gun)?

//Petri

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The vampire must strikes with the gun.

Rulebook:

6.4.2. Determine Range
If a minion uses the maneuver from a strike card or a
weapon, he is effectively choosing his strike as well.

6.4.3. Strike
1. Choose Strike
If a minion has used a maneuver from a strike (either a
strike card or a weapon) this round, then he cannot choose
any other strike for his initial strike of the round.
